# FY 2018 monthly net budget receipts from Excise taxes (millions of dollars)
# Source: Treasury Bulletin FFO-2, On-Budget and Off-Budget Receipts by Source
excise = [
    8702,   # Oct 2017
    7220,   # Nov 2017
    7113,   # Dec 2017
    8389,   # Jan 2018
    5263,   # Feb 2018
    6736,   # Mar 2018
    7438,   # Apr 2018
    7437,   # May 2018
    7280,   # Jun 2018
    7765,   # Jul 2018
    6921,   # Aug 2018
    7693,   # Sep 2018
]

mean = sum(excise) / len(excise)
mad = sum(abs(x - mean) for x in excise) / len(excise)
print(round(mad, 3))
